name: Chillwind Point
summary: Cold drafts sweep through Chillwind Point, a rocky rise above the mountain pass. The ancient troll ruin sits where Hillsbrad Foothills, the Alterac Mountains, and the Western Plaguelands meet, and Bath'rah the Windwatcher lives among its stones.

sections.title: A Bitter Crossroads
sections.body: Chillwind Point overlooks the ravine from Hillsbrad's edge. The pass leads into the Western Plaguelands, while the Alterac Mountains rise nearby. Long before Lordaeron claimed these routes, ancient trolls built stone structures on the heights. Their weather-beaten remains still face the elements. Cold winds now blow south through the ravine, carrying the chill of the fallen north into the foothills below.

sections.title: The Windwatcher
sections.body: Bath'rah the Windwatcher lives among the old stones at Chillwind Point. The jungle troll hermit communes with the violent gales that course through the gap. Despite the bleak exposure and the nearby Scourge-ravaged lands, his camp is not entirely deserted. Travelers and shamans heading north often seek him out to learn the secrets of the mountain currents.

faq.answer: Chillwind Point is an ancient troll ruin on a high rise overlooking the pass between Hillsbrad, Alterac, and the Western Plaguelands. Its name comes from the biting drafts that whistle through the nearby gorge.

faq.q: Is Chillwind Point the same as Chillwind Camp?
faq.answer: No. Chillwind Camp is the fortified Alliance and Argent Dawn outpost just north across the border, inside the Western Plaguelands. Chillwind Point is the ruined troll rise to the south.
Bath'rah the Windwatcher lives alone among the ruins. The friendly jungle troll studies the winds and aids elemental seekers and shamans who brave the pass.

faq.q: Why is it so cold here?
faq.answer: A narrow mountain ravine beside Chillwind Point funnels freezing drafts from the high northern regions and the blighted Western Plaguelands down into the lower foothills.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can study the pass's wild, funneling gusts with the hermit Bath'rah the Windwatcher, who draws practitioners seeking elemental focus.
As an Alliance traveler, you find these ancient ruins just south of the border post at Chillwind Camp, where the contested foothills give way to the Plaguelands.
